about: Gate 65 block L (the old block K): vs Computer with the human playing Black, the human's own clock flags; L0e reads WHICH side flagged off the card ('You lose', never 'You win'), L0c2 waits for the engine's reply before pBefore is read, and L1/L1b/L1c hold that the board refuses a legal Black move after the flag. Graded at 375x730 (the block's column) and 375x761 with his insets (added #553 B3). NOT COVERED: 320x568 and landscape (each flag costs a real 60-second clock; the block's header records the cost choice).

breaks.name: the-time-card-names-the-wrong-side
breaks.why: the vs-Computer result card's side is inverted, so the human's own flag reads 'Time! You win!' - the card still says Time!, which is all the old K0e read

breaks.name: a-flagged-game-takes-moves-again
breaks.why: humanCanMove's playEnd guard is gone, so after the human's clock flags the board accepts f6-g8 (the #438 defect this cell guards)
